verdict.rationale: Vanta documents obtaining an API access token to interact with the Manage Vanta API and MCP server (vanta-docs-1, vanta-docs-6/28), implying some credential-based auth for agents, but there is no explicit documentation of granular, least-privilege scoping (e.g., per-resource or per-action permission scopes) for these tokens. Missing for 10: explicit scoped/role-based API key creation UI or docs, permission-level granularity controls, and any independent confirmation that tokens can be restricted to minimal agent actions.
